## What I do {#services}

::: {.grid .service-grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .service-card}
### {{< bi graph-up >}} Data Science & AI {#svc-data-ai}
- Statistical analysis and modelling you can defend
- Models for monitoring, anomaly detection, prediction
- On-premises RAG and LLM integration, no data leaves your network
- Reproducible pipelines and reports your domain experts can read
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .service-card}
### {{< bi shield-lock >}} High-Security Audits {#svc-audits}
- Security audits of medical and industrial software (MDR, IEC 62443, FDA guidance)
- Threat modelling and code review for regulated environments
- Formal verification (Lean 4) for critical components
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .service-card}
### {{< bi cpu >}} Reverse Engineering {#svc-reverse-engineering}
- Analysis of binaries, firmware and undocumented protocols
- Vulnerability research with coordinated, responsible disclosure
- Written findings your engineers can act on
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .service-card}
### {{< bi phone >}} App & Software Development {#svc-apps}
- Web, desktop and mobile apps, prototype to product
- Backend, systems and embedded code in Rust, Python, C/C++
- Clinical front-ends with access control and audit trails
- Handover with docs, tests and a deployment your team can run
:::

:::

## Questions clients ask {#faq}

### Can you work with sensitive patient or company data?

Yes. I design for data minimisation, access control and auditability, and can deploy
AI systems such as RAG and LLMs on-premises so sensitive data stays in your network.
I can sign an NDA before reviewing project details.

### Do you take on small, clearly scoped projects?

Yes. An engagement can begin with a security review, feasibility assessment, prototype
or fixed-scope development task. After the free call, you receive a written proposal
with scope, timeline and price.

### Do you work remotely or on-site?

Both. Most work can be delivered remotely across Germany and Europe. On-site work is
also possible; travel and on-site costs are quoted separately based on the location
and duration of the engagement.

### What do you deliver?

Depending on the engagement: actionable audit findings, production-ready code in your
repository, reproducible analysis, tests, documentation and a handover your team can
operate independently. I can also deliver complete applications, including backend,
deployment and server setup. If you would like ongoing operation, updates or support,
maintenance fees may apply and are agreed in advance.
